best_hook.why: Bedridden duchess realizes her own family is poisoning her in her bed; instant betrayal stakes.

best_cliffhanger.why: Duchess grips the maid and demands where she got the ring; identity reveal hangs unanswered.

must_promos.why: Opens on the poisoning betrayal, establishes the maid as a cast-out noble, then the ring sighting, gasp and frantic 'Where did you get this ring?' cut before any answer.

standalone_risk: A stranger does not know why the ring matters to the Duchess (her lost son) or that Juliana is a disguised noblewoman, so the ring reaction reads as mystery without stakes; Rupert and Catherine are only names.
notes: Quiet whispered bedside scene with no antagonist on screen; the payoff of the ring setup lands in episode 27, which is the stronger ad.
